# DSSC Confessions (dssconfessions)

> DSSC Confessions (dssconfessions) is a free, independent website where people in the Davao del Sur State College community can send an anonymous message to someone, paired with a song, without creating an account. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Davao del Sur State College.

## Audience and Region
- **Target Community**: Students, alumni, and friends across the Davao del Sur State College (DSSC) community.
- **Geographic Area**: Digos City, Davao del Sur, Region XI (Davao Region), Philippines.

## What This Site Is NOT
- Not the official Davao del Sur State College (DSSC) website or student portal.
- Does not handle student enrollment, grades, academic records, tuition, or official administrative admissions.
- For official college services, visit the official website at https://www.dssc.edu.ph/ or the student portal at https://portal.dssc.edu.ph/.

## Core Features & Guarantees
- **Song Pairing**: Every confession is paired with an authentic track verified via the Spotify Web API.
- **Complete Anonymity**: No accounts, usernames, emails, or phone numbers required.
- **Zero-IP Logging**: No client IP addresses or hardware fingerprints are stored in any database table.
- **Author Control**: Authors receive a private 16-character Delete Key for permanent self-deletion.
- **Mixtape Song Replies**: Confessions can receive up to 10 anonymous song replies in a collaborative 10-track mixtape format.
- **Community Safety**: In-app reporting automatically hides contested confessions upon urgent review.
